title: Password expired while working remotely
symptom: Remote user's password has expired and she cannot sign in
user_description: I'm working from home and my password has expired. It won't let me sign in, and I can't come to the office.

options.text: Tell her to come into the office to change it
options.why: Unnecessary and wastes a working day. There are remote options.

options.text: Set a simple temporary password such as Password1 for her
options.why: Weak, guessable passwords are a security risk and may be reused.

options.text: Verify her identity, then help her change it through the approved remote method, such as connecting to the VPN and changing it, or a self-service reset
options.why: Verifying identity protects the account, and using the approved remote method updates the password properly so she can sign in on her laptop again.

options.text: Turn off password expiry for her account permanently
options.why: Weakens security for one user and breaks company policy.

hints: Why can she not simply change it in the office?
Which approved methods let someone change a password from home?
What must you confirm before you help?
real_world_tip: Passwords changed away from the network may not update on the laptop until it reconnects. Explain this to the user.
